International Business Programme – Østfold University of Applied Sciences
International Business Programme
In today’s rapidly evolving and interconnected world, successful leaders in both the private and public sectors must think and act globally. They are expected to navigate international markets, understand global institutions, and drive innovation across borders with confidence and responsibility.
The Bachelor’s Programme in International Business at Østfold University of Applied Sciences equips students with the essential tools and insights to thrive in this environment. With a strong foundation in international economics, entrepreneurship, and global business strategy, our programme prepares future professionals to lead with impact.
We offer a dynamic and internationally focused curriculum that is open to students from Norway and around the world. Join us for a comprehensive, real-world business education designed to expand your global mindset and career opportunities.

All courses are taught at our campus in Halden.
The programme is an international alternative integrated into the ordinary curriculum, so you will meet and work with Norwegian students. Students may take the courses as a full-year study, single semester, or as individual courses.
